verdicts.reason: A destroys the hero: the SALE circles are gone, the letters are tiny, scattered down the left edge and out of order (E above S-A-L), the 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' headline is small and floats mid-canvas, and the bottom third is dead space with a stray fragment. B keeps the S-A-L-E circles in the right order, but the letters sit off-centre and slip onto the circle rims, the stack is jammed against the right edge, the headline is undersized at top-left, and there is an odd shrunken copy of the artwork in the top-right corner. Both are broken; B is less bad because the hero device and its reading order survive.
